contract: Essential visible claims are lossless against the authenticated original; complete original provenance remains unchanged in the external sidecar. Display alone is not a full original-result encoding.

visible_per_record.entries[].id: Exact record identity, original order preserved
visible_per_record.entries[].payload.subject: Entire original subject object, including exact path/qualname/node_kind
visible_per_record.entries[].payload.expected.text: Exact UTF-8 source prefix in ordinary fenced Python block; synthetic fence newline explicitly flagged and removed for verification
visible_per_record.entries[].payload.expected.truncated: Exact boolean; no full-definition or behavior inference
visible_per_record.entries[].label: Exact original trust label
visible_per_record.entries[].state_type: Exact optional state type; absent stays absent

visible_shared.backend: Exact original backend label, not blinded
visible_shared.truncated: Exact original selection truncation under selection_truncated
visible_shared.withheld: Entire original withheld array, order and all fields retained
visible_shared.audit_receipt: Exact original receipt under original_audit_receipt; does not authenticate new display
visible_shared.entries[].payload.type: Shared kind, only if every record is source_excerpt_equals
visible_shared.entries[].payload.expected.format: Shared literal_format, only if identical in every record

audit_only.query: Redundant query echo; original tool arguments and old result retained. Selection query is not modified.
audit_only.response_format: Old compact format remains in original result; new display has explicit distinct format
audit_only.schema_version: Old schema version retained in original result; strict input-version gate before projection
audit_only.entries[].payload.origin_source: Full source hash/size/index provenance retained in original full/compact packet; duplicate origin path must equal visible subject path. No current-source or behavioral validation claim is added.

unknown_semantics: Unknown top-level/record/payload/expected fields refused; nonempty homogeneous literal packets only. Empty, mixed-kind and error cases require separately designed explicit fallback before any production use.
binding: Sidecar SHA binds original full result, original compact/model result, old receipt, exact new display and this field policy. Unsigned local integrity only; production requires a distinct new projection receipt and verifier.
